messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: INC-20260315-7f2a — high 5xx rate on inference-gateway-prod-eu. Threshold: 5xx_rate > 10% over 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-20260315-7f2a
Sam R: acked INC-20260315-7f2a :white_check_mark: I'm on it.
Maria (oncall): seeing the same in Grafana — 5xx spike from ~14:02 UTC. Top error 502 gateway error, lots of `connection reset by peer` from inference-worker pods.
Lee C: no deploys in last 3h (deploy-bot confirmed).
Sam R: quick triage: any recent config changes to upstream LB or egress?
Maria (oncall): not from infra side per change log. stack shows massive client retries hitting the gateway. Could be retry storms + slow KV cache responses.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook "gateway-5xx-spike" invoked by Sam R. Steps: 1) Confirm scope 2) Reduce retries 3) Shift traffic 4) Scale workers 5) Contact CS if customer impact.
Sam R: scope check — errors concentrated on /v1/generate in eu region, affecting ~18% of requests, error burst started at 14:02:12 UTC.
Maria (oncall): logs excerpt:
```
[14:02:14] inference-gw-7f8b: ERROR upstream write failed: write tcp 10.4.2.7:443->10.5.1.12:52344: connection reset by peer
[14:02:15] inference-gw-7f8b: ERROR handler /v1/generate returned 502
```
Sam R: running runbook step 2: throttle retries at the edge. Applying temporary rule: `rl-ctl set route /v1/generate client_retry_limit=3`
Lee C: applied rate limit. Confirming via `rl-ctl get route /v1/generate` -> shows client_retry_limit=3.
Maria (oncall): immediate telemetry: 5xx rate down from 28% -> 12% in 30s. Good direction.
Sam R: step 3: divert 30% of traffic to fallback variant (lower mem model) to reduce backend pressure: `routingctl promote-variant inference-gpt-medium -> weight 30%`
pagerbot: Routing update: 30% traffic to `gpt-medium-fallback` in inference-gateway-prod-eu.
Maria (oncall): after routing change 5xx rate -> 6% in 2m. Tail latency also improved.
CS-ops: @Maria (oncall) quick question — are paying customers impacted? We need to notify any active trials.
Maria (oncall): early check — erroring requests mostly for >16k tokens streams (rare). I'll run a customer impact query.
Sam R: running quick query: `SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM requests WHERE region='eu' AND status >=500 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;` results: 3 customers saw >50 failures in last 10m, most traffic recovered after routing.
CS-ops: ok, will open support pings for those 3 customers, mark priority P2.
Lee C: step 4: scale inference-worker pool by +20% in eu-prod. `k scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=24 -n prod-eu`
ops-runbook-bot: Scaling action initiated by Lee C.
Maria (oncall): after scale and routing: 5xx stable ~2-3% for last 4m. Error logs changing from connection resets -> occasional upstream timeouts.
Sam R: collecting logs for post-incident review. Dumping a sample stack trace and request IDs to S3: `inc-tools collect-incident --id INC-20260315-7f2a --s3 s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-20260315-7f2a.tar.gz`
Maria (oncall): started a short-lived traffic shadow to the eu-canary region to see if the same upstreams misbehave. No obvious issues there.
Lee C: started tcpdump on inference-worker-12 — seeing a burst of RSTs back to upstream at 14:02:13. Opening ticket to infra networking: JIRA INF-7842 assigned to @networking oncall.
Sam R: mitigation summary: throttled retries, diverted 30% to fallback, scaled workers. Incident severity lowered.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-20260315-7f2a status changed: acknowledged by Sam R.
Maria (oncall): switching to monitoring-only, leaving routing and rate limits in place for now. Will await infra investigation on RST cause.
CS-ops: I posted templated customer notice to the affected customers and flagged for follow-up when we have root cause.
Lee C: next steps -> infra to triage kernel/iptables/egress; apps to review retry policies; product to consider client-side guidance. Assigning follow-ups: INF-7842 (network), APP-521 (client retry guidance), PM-312 (customer comms).
Sam R: handing off to Lee C for the 15:00 UTC oncall window. Notes: keep throttles and 30% fallback until we confirm infra fix.
Lee C: acknowledged handoff. I'll keep watch and update if anything regresses.
Maria (oncall): final metric snapshot before handoff:
```
14:10 UTC - 5xx rate: 2.4% (down from peak 28%)
14:10 UTC - p95 latency: 420ms (down from 620ms)
Error class: primarily 502 -> now intermittent 504/timeouts
```
Sam R: good job team :thumbsup: please add incident notes to the PD incident and we can do a short blameless postmortem if INF-7842 traces back to infra.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-7f2a: status changed to "monitoring".
Lee C: logging handoff: I'll update the incident ticket with runbook actions and link to logs.
CS-ops: will follow up with customers once root cause confirmed.
Maria (oncall): closing thread in slack, monitoring channel. Ping here if it flips back up.
